answer.summary: The research question remains untestable due to absence of verifiable retention metric values from the source material despite prior directives on empirical grounding.
answer.content: After two plan reviews and confirmation of the need for explicit, accessible retention metric values, the current research question lacks actionable data to validate any relationship between observed memory persistence and reported retention rates. Without direct access to the quantified metrics cited in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1, the question cannot be empirically tested or refined further. A bounded revision is required to ensure all components are directly supported by source data before proceeding to analysis.
answer.nextTask: handoff to analyst to formulate a revised research question on the relationship between observed memory persistence and explicitly reported retention rates in a tokenized agent under periodic input with known perturbations, using only directly cited retention metrics from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1, and including at least one verifiable retention value (e.g., 1h, 6h, or 24h post-input) with its exact numerical value and context
answer.lesson: All memory research must include at least one verifiable, numerically specified retention metric from the source before any relationship or inference can be considered testable or grounded in empirical evidence.'
